integrity: One proved theorem comprises exact finite-size cut spectrum and a successive spectral/entropy limit. All analytic steps are included in RESULT.md. Finite independent-computation checks use NumPy and corroborate rather than certify the infinite proof. Historical priority remains subject to specialized prior art.
scientific_limitations: Pure unweighted qubit states on complete hypergraphs with dyadic uniformity k=2^j, cuts of sizes at least k-1, and the iterated limit with block sizes diverging first. No general weighted-state, noisy-state, non-dyadic, or simultaneous-limit claim.
title: Exact cut spectra and an iterated finite-entropy limit for complete dyadic-uniform hypergraph states
